title: Send a Telegram notification (self-notify)
description:
Synchronous, no credit. Push a notification to YOUR OWN connected
Telegram chat. Requires `Connect Telegram` to have been completed at
https://widecast.ai/#setup; if not, the response is `400
telegram_not_connected` + the setup URL in details.

fields.name: message
fields.label: Message (≤ 4000 bytes; ≤ 1024 bytes if photo/video set)
fields.placeholder: Your video is ready to review!

fields.name: photo_url
fields.label: Photo URL (optional, mutually exclusive with video URL)

fields.name: video_url
fields.label: Video URL (optional, mutually exclusive with photo URL)

use_cases.title: 💬 Plain text notification
use_cases.description: Just push a text message to the user's own Telegram chat. The simplest mode — no formatting, no attachments.

request.message: Your video is ready to review! Open the dashboard to pick scenes.

use_cases.title: ✨ HTML-formatted message
use_cases.description: Use a small subset of HTML tags (`b`, `i`, `u`, `s`, `code`, `pre`, `a`) for emphasis or links. Other tags are stripped server-side.
